oslo.town for iOS — Icon Audit

22 Phosphor icons used (29 call sites) 92 SF Symbols used (141 call sites)

Generated from a code sweep of app + SDK sources (tests excluded). Previews are rendered locally. The in use badge marks the current style. For each Phosphor icon: the "light" column shows Phosphor's thin-weight alternative; post-action icons (boost / favourite / bookmark) toggle between outline and fill at runtime. For SF Symbols: "ultraLight" shows the thin-weight render, and "counterpart" shows the fill/outline sibling when one exists ("—" means none).
